title: Update on building a voxel survival/colony sim
author: SweetKarmaz
selftext: Added harvestables, a basic UI, and starting working on the inventory system. Next is to integrate a recipe system for crafting, flesh out the UI a bit, then work on the construction components. Once I can collect base items, craft tools, harvest items that require tools, and construct buildings, will do another video.
